jobs.memory_rationale: Fixed full-context streamed learner/Adam shapes.22GiB allocated and24GiB reserved provide roughly36percent above observed16.20/17.57GiB peaks;8GiB RSS retains qualified allowance for CPU image, checkpoints and finalization. No automatic cap expansion.
jobs.duration_rationale: Maximum of four synchronized discarded updates, including both objectives on the assigned device, scaled to all2300 updates.50percent covers long-run contention/variance;900s separately covers imports/setup/restoration/two checkpoint writes. These are limits, not a completion guarantee.
